name: Stats
description: Grid of key numbers / KPIs with an optional header. Layouts: one row of four, a dark 2x2 'big four' with a callout quote, a divider-separated inline row, or a split with the header left and the grid right.
when_to_use: Compact proof through numbers — years of experience, projects, satisfaction rates. Use Credibility (stats-banner) when the numbers should read as third-party trust signals; use Intro (stacked) to attach stats to an introduction.
capabilities: four layouts: row, big-four dark, inline with dividers, split head/grid
value + label + small sub-caption per stat
callout quote below the grid (bigfour variant)

variants.description: 2x2 grid on dark background with large numbers; renders the callout quote.
Header block left, stat grid right.

breakpoints.mobile: Stats wrap to 2 columns then 1; inline stacks with a divider between; split stacks header above the grid.
breakpoints.desktop: row: 4 KPIs each under a 2px top rule. bigfour: dark 2x2 with 120px numbers + callout. inline: 4 KPIs between two rules, vertical dividers. split: 0.9/1.1 header-left + 2x2 grid-right.

ai.prompt_summary: Stats: KPI grid aligned to Figma 773:47170. Settings: variant (row|bigfour|inline|split), eyebrow, headline, intro, callout (quote, bigfour only). Numbers in items[] (min 1): { value (e.g. 120+, 98%, 18), label, sub (small caption) }. row/split render each KPI under a rule; bigfour is a dark 2x2 with 120px numbers + a callout quote; inline sits between two rules with vertical dividers (no sub).
ai.content_guidelines: Provide exactly 4 stats for row, bigfour, inline and split. Values short with unit/suffix baked in (40+, 98%); labels 1-3 words; sub optional one-liner (not shown in the inline variant).

field_hints.items.value: Display string including suffix — no separate unit field.
field_hints.callout: Only rendered by the bigfour variant, as a quote below the grid.
